items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: West Indies Blues was uh, a number thawed up by Pierron and uh, I don't know who else had anything to do with it... Pete wrote that too. Him and Pierron I think.

ctx.x: A little break. How much reading did you all do on a tune like that?

Well uh, we, we part of it was a bunch of gifted musicians. We practically memorized all those numbers. See? You know that that is the sport. We played them so many times. See? And we just memorized them. In fact we played a whole, a waterfall show without any music. All our own numbers. West Indies Blues was uh, a number thawed up by Pierron and uh, I don't know who else had anything to do with it. I sang it all the way through. In fact I was entertaining the band at all times. That's Mama's Gone Goodbye. Pete…
I think he told me he wrote the music and Pierron wrote the words.
